newsitem.title: UK: Cookson sees H1 in line, profit growth in H2.
newsitem.headline: Cookson sees H1 in line, profit growth in H2.

text.p: British electronic and plastic industrial materials company Cookson Group Plc said on Friday it expected first-half results to be in line with market expectations and predicted profit growth in the second half.

"For the second half, as indicated in March, we expect to return to growth in earnings, the extent of which depends on the pace of the recovery in the electronics industry," chief executive Richard Oster added in a statement from the firm's annual meeting.
